# partiteai_mcp_connection_subscription (Resource)

One subscription of a tunnel MCP connection. A subscription decides which relays serve which conversations: a conversation tagged `env=dev` reaches a development relay, one tagged `developer=bob` reaches Bob's workstation, one tagged `tenant=acme` reaches that customer's deployment.

Subscriptions do not rank against each other. A conversation may be eligible for several, and whichever relay polls first takes the message, so an overlap is redundancy rather than a conflict.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mcp_connection_id` (String) The tunnel connection this subscription belongs to.
- `name` (String) Names the subscription within its connection.

### Optional

- `criteria` (Attributes Set) Tags a conversation must carry for this subscription to serve it. Every criterion has to match, and matching is containment: a criterion of `env=dev` matches a conversation tagged both `env=dev` and `env=staging`.

Left out, the subscription accepts every conversation on the connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--criteria))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `criteria`

Required:

- `name` (String) Tag name.
- `value` (String) Tag value.
